cases.sentence: Все ___ у царских ворот преклоняли колени и воздавали Аману честь, потому что так постановил о нем царь.
cases.explain: «царские чиновники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: All the king’s servants who were in the king’s gate bowed down, and paid homage to Haman; for the king had so commanded concerning him. But Mordecai didn’t bow down or pay him homage.

cases.explain: «Царские чиновники» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: Then the king’s servants, who were in the king’s gate, said to Mordecai, “Why do you disobey the king’s commandment?”

cases.sentence: В двенадцатом году правления царя Ксеркса, в ___, месяце нисане , бросали перед Аманом «пур», что означает «жребий», чтобы выбрать день и месяц.
cases.explain: «первом месяце» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, and chose the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

cases.sentence: И жребий пал на ___, месяц адар .
cases.explain: «двенадцатый месяц» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: In the first month, which is the month Nisan, in the twelfth year of King Ahasuerus, they cast Pur, that is, the lot, before Haman from day to day, and from month to month, and chose the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

cases.sentence: Если угодно царю, пусть выйдет указ, чтобы их погубить, а я отвешу десять тысяч талантов серебра в руки ___, чтобы они внесли его в царскую сокровищницу.
cases.explain: «царских казначеев» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: If it pleases the king, let it be written that they be destroyed; and I will pay ten thousand talents of silver into the hands of those who are in charge of the king’s business, to bring it into the king’s treasuries.”

cases.sentence: В тринадцатый день ___ были призваны царские писари.
cases.explain: «первого месяца» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Then the king’s scribes were called in on the first month, on the thirteenth day of the month; and all that Haman commanded was written to the king’s local governors, and to the governors who were over every province, and to the princes of every people, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language. It was written in the name of King Ahasuerus, and it was sealed with the king’s ring.

cases.explain: «царским сатрапам» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
